prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a stunning luxury fashion magazine cover for the fictional brand VELOUR, with a bold silver serif masthead at the top. Center an adult white woman with soft facial features, big doe eyes, rosy cheeks and loosely pinned-up auburn hair with soft face-framing tendrils. She stands tall with one hand resting lightly on her collarbone, the other hanging naturally at her side, chin slightly tilted upward, lips softly closed and eyes locked on the camera with effortless calm. She wears a floor-length emerald green liquid satin column gown, sleek and form-fitting through the body, with a dramatic sculptural one-shoulder asymmetric neckline rising into a sharp architectural petal on the left side. A long sheer emerald overlay trails behind her like smoke, with one bare arm and one arm wrapped in a single sheer emerald glove to the elbow. She stands on a cracked pale marble floor in the clean cream-white studio shown in the source image, with a deep charcoal gradient available as a darker editorial variation. Use a strong key light from the upper left casting sharp elegant shadows on her face and collarbone and a faint warm rim light outlining her silhouette. Add the supplied cover typography: DARK ROMANCE / THE NEW SEASON; BEYOND LIMITS / VERDANT POWER; REIGN & RADIANCE. Vertical 9:13, ultra-photorealistic, 8K and cinematic color grading. Preserve the source gown, pose, cream studio, marble floor and editorial hierarchy.
